scope: Chapter 2 of the Moin scene prototype (src/story/scenes/02.ts): character lines, replays, lock, oral practice and new story phrases with plurals
notes: Whisper writes numbers as digits (25, 0151 32 54 19, A38); every such take was compared by hand and says the numbers in words as written.
All three takes of 'Petersen, Büro, Club Kiellinie, Moin! Wer ist da? Hallo?' were cut off at the end; six more seeds were generated and the one ending at -34.4 dB was kept.
For 'Zwölf … elf! Noch elf Tage!' the take where Whisper hears both numbers was chosen over one that dropped 'elf'.
tails.py passes on all 69 imported files (no fragment after the phrase, no clipped ending).
